definitions.gloss: copy; duplicate; record kept for reference
definitions.explanation: A copy or duplicate of a document, receipt, or record kept for one's own reference. Common in business and administrative contexts.
A person or thing held in reserve, ready to step in when needed. Used in sports for substitute players and in other contexts for backups.

examples.english: The relief pitcher took the mound and brilliantly closed out the game.

notes:
USAGE: {控|ひか}え is the noun form of {控|ひか}える (to refrain; to note down; to wait). As a noun, its two main meanings are (1) a duplicate/copy kept for reference and (2) a reserve/backup.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {控|ひか}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to make a copy
- {控|ひか}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: reserve player, substitute
- {控|ひか}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go to the bench, to step back to a backup role
- {控|ひか}え{室|しつ}: waiting room, green room
